title: 许天师圣诞祝寿祈福法事
title_en: Announcement: Prayer Ceremony for Patriarch Xu Tianshi's Birthday
body:
农历正月二十八，恭逢净明祖师神功妙济真君、净明普化天尊许天师圣诞。
许天师为净明道重要祖师，历代净明弟子尊奉祖师圣德，传承净明忠孝之教。值此祖师圣诞吉辰，为恭祝许天师圣寿，感念祖师弘道济世之德，美国阳翥道教协会特启建许天师圣诞祝寿祈福法会。
法会依道教传统科仪设坛奉供，敬香礼圣，上表启奏，恭祝祖师圣寿无疆、道炁长存，并为十方善信祈福禳灾。
为参加法会及随坛祈福善信上表祈愿，祈求祖师慈悲护佑，消灾解厄、增福延寿、身心康泰、家庭和顺、事业顺遂、所愿吉祥。
美国阳翥道教协会谨以虔诚之心礼敬祖师，弘扬净明道统，传承祖师济世利人之精神，并愿祖师慈光普照，护佑十方，福生无量天尊。
body_en:
On the twenty-eighth day of the first lunar month, we respectfully commemorate the sacred birthday of Celestial Master Xu, the Jingming Patriarch, honored as the Zhenjun of Divine Merit and Wondrous Salvation and the Heavenly Worthy of Jingming Universal Transformation.

Celestial Master Xu is an important patriarch of the Jingming Taoist tradition. For generations, Jingming disciples have revered his sacred virtue and carried forward the Jingming teachings of loyalty and filial piety. On this auspicious occasion of the Patriarch’s sacred birthday, the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America will hold a Birthday Celebration and Blessing Ceremony for Celestial Master Xu to honor the Patriarch and commemorate his virtue in spreading the Dao and benefiting the world.

In accordance with traditional Taoist ritual practices, an altar will be established and offerings presented. Incense will be offered, the sacred ones will be honored, and memorials will be formally presented to the celestial realm. The ceremony will respectfully celebrate the Patriarch’s sacred birthday and pray for blessings and the removal of misfortune on behalf of devotees.

Prayers and memorials will also be offered on behalf of those participating in the ceremony and those requesting blessings, praying for the compassionate protection of the Patriarch, the dispelling of calamities and difficulties, increased blessings and longevity, health and well-being, harmony within the family, success in one’s endeavors, and the fulfillment of virtuous wishes.

With sincere devotion, the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America honors the Patriarch, carries forward the Jingming Taoist lineage, and preserves his spirit of benefiting and serving all beings. May the compassionate light of the Patriarch shine universally and protect all in the ten directions.

Fusheng Wuliang Tianzun.
